## 维护者速读
- 是什么：问题卡本身的纯组件：单题点一下就发，两题翻页最后停在「发送」，「自己输入…」，跳过，键盘和读屏，所有语种文案。还不接到对话里。

## What to do (in `plugin-chatbot`, props in, events out)
1. Input: the parsed envelope (Q1 (#37872) types). Output events: `onAnswer(text)`, `onSkip()`.
2. Single question: clicking an option sends immediately.
3. Two questions: an option on question 1 moves to question 2; on question 2 the card does NOT auto-send, it stops on 「发送」 with a one-line summary; 「上一题」 keeps the choices.
4. 「自己输入…」: always the last item, a one-line input; typing selects it (clears others); Enter = next / send.
5. Answer text: one question → the chosen label or typed text; two → one line each `header：answer` (question text when no header).
6. Options show `description` as a second grey line (no hover on mobile); `recommended` shows a 「推荐」 tag.
7. Keyboard: no forced focus move; when focus is inside the card, digits 1–4 pick options, ↑↓ move, ⌘/Ctrl+↵ next / send. Screen reader: radiogroup with 「第 1/2 题」; an `aria-live` 「有一个问题待回答」 announcement (Q2b triggers it).
8. Size: max height about 60% of the input area, scrolls inside, bottom buttons fixed; works in full screen, narrow drawer and mobile drawer.
9. Strings in all current locales: 「第 {n}/{total} 题」「自己输入…」「跳过」「上一题」「下一题」「发送」「推荐」「AI 问：」「有一个问题待回答」. Arabic right-to-left.
10. The card keeps its selected state when the parent re-renders it after a failed send (Q2b relies on this).

## Acceptance
- Component tests: single-click send, two-question flow with back, typed answer, skip, keyboard, RTL, answer-text composition.
